skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weaken] on the main target (ATK reduced by 20% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 130% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire column, with a 100% chance to inflict [Weaken] on the main target (ATK reduced by 30% for 1 turn).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20. When deployed together with the Cross Button, the Mourning Overall Pants' ATK is increased by 20% until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20. When deployed together with the Cross Button, the Mourning Overall Pants' ATK is increased by 30% until the end of battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20. When deployed together with the Cross Button, the Mourning Overall Pants' ATK is increased by 35% until the end of battle.

effects.desc: Unfavorable effect reduces the target's damage reduction rate by 30% for the duration.
